articles.title: WWE Raw results, grades (Oct. 5): Roman Reigns exerts his control; Liv Morgan vs. Becky Lynch ends in double DQ
articles.summary: Roman Reigns returned, while Liv Morgan and Becky Lynch battled for a shot at Stephanie Vaquer's Women's World Title on the "WWE Raw" go-home show as Money in the Bank looms.
articles.body: "WWE Raw" was in St. Louis at the Enterprise Center on this Monday, Oct. 5. The Money in the Bank go-home show was lackluster, to put it bluntly. But it at least gave us some clarity for Saturday's card, with a non-finish in the main event.Finalizing the inevitableEveryone and their dog knew we were getting a Stephanie Vaquer vs. Becky Lynch vs. Liv Morgan triple-threat Women's World Championship match at some point. To get there, we apparently needed a unicorn-esque double DQ in Lynch and Morgan's No. 1 contender match tonight. All three will now collide at Money In the Bank.Plenty of silliness closed out what was expected to be a solid match. The finish ultimately rendered it all moot though, as Vaquer attacked Lynch and Morgan at the same time — after the usual Judgment Day shenanigans.I mean, seriously, this was an egregious usage of interference and referee stupidity. I'm talking Jessika Carr blatantly ignoring Raquel Rodriguez putting Morgan's foot on the ropes. Things of that nature.The Judgment Day get involved but @BeckyLynchWWE SURVIVES 😎 pic.twitter.com/sBuRGeN411— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 To make it all the funnier, Vaquer called out "Raw" general manager Adam Pearce after she ruined the match. He sauntered out from the back, seemingly confused, like he wasn't even watching his own show's main event — one that consisted of the millionth Judgment Day interference he's ignored for what feels like 20 years.Really, everything that happened tonight made Pearce look even worse than he already has throughout this saga. And the "Raw' GM wasn't done either. (More on that later.)A TRIPLE THREAT MATCH AT #MITB!?!? 🙌IT IS OFFICIAL!! @Steph_Vaquer pic.twitter.com/E9z3T4KY4P— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 Monday Night ReturnsIt must be highlighted that any time Roman Reigns isn't on back-to-back episodes of WWE TV, his subsequent appearance is advertised as a "return." That'd be OK if it didn't happen all the time — and if he did more than just talk for less than 20 minutes of a two-and-a-half-hour show. Tonight's "Raw" was a great example of the bait tactic WWE loves these days.The OTC is HERE and so is LA KNIGHT....YEAH!!! 🙌@WWERomanReigns pic.twitter.com/DzBEFVnWKZ— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 That said, Reigns' immediate interaction and promo battle with LA Knight was fantastic. They kept it purely verbal in the ring before their championship match on Saturday. I've completely lost all faith in Knight pulling off the win, so any upset will be even sweeter if he actually does it. (And he should.)But two things are facts: 1) Everything Knight said is true, and, 2) these two men have undeniable chemistry."You're a complainer" 🤯@WWERomanReigns is telling LA Knight OFF! pic.twitter.com/1LE5BmL1XK— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 "You're the most manufactured, corporate puppet, industry plant I've ever seen in my life." 😳@RealLAKnight will NOT back down from the OTC! pic.twitter.com/GS97kf22mO— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 The 946 problemThis angle has become the most "wrestling thing" ever. And if it's all just a roundabout way for WWE to casually sneak Solo Sikoa back into the Bloodline, they will have done that man a massive disservice, given how great he's been by himself or with Knight.SOLO IS BACK 🔥 pic.twitter.com/258Lb4rWKW— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 Reigns oddly wants nothing to do with any of this, and we'll dive into that more later this week in our Uncrowned Horsemen preview for Money in the Bank.But as for Pearce, as previously alluded to, he's allowing 946 to wrestle a match — aka come to work — next week after Jaida Parker literally attempted murder on Jacob Fatu last week.There's no justifying any of this, and WWE isn't trying, which is why it's hilariously just kind of "wrestling being wrestling." But man, is it funny to think about.Ain't NOBODY safe from the 946 😳 pic.twitter.com/1cWc39Awx2— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 👑 Uncrowned Gem of the Night 👑 Speaking of murder attempts, Paul Heyman wants Bronson Reed to end Oba Femi. Permanently. By squishing him. Squishing him with high-impact blows from his body mass at a voluminous rate — otherwise known as a "Tsunami" in wrestling terms.TSUNAMI 🌊@HeymanHustle pic.twitter.com/a9JuEnGTgz— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 This was just great, honestly. And mostly because it was refreshing to see Paul Heyman back doing promo work. The less we see of him, the more appearances like this remind us how great he is. It came after Oba Femi ran through The Vision following their loss tonight to Penta and Je'Von Evans. That's right. The World Tag Team Champions casually lost on a Monday night. I'm not even sure they mentioned the titles during the match.Nonetheless, all this Femi stalling can only last so long, which makes whatever happens this Saturday all the more intriguing. But as of right now, "The Ruler" is treading water and doing nothing of substance."I'm going to PUNISH you" 😲@Obaofwwe is READY for Bronson Reed at #MITB! pic.twitter.com/qKHhNDPxhe— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 OBA FEMI is HERE!! 👏@Obaofwwe pic.twitter.com/vFx7f39bqY— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 I give this "Raw" a crown score of: 5/10 👑WWE Raw full card results and match grades:Women's World Championship No. 1 Contender match: Becky Lynch vs. Liv Morgan ends via double DQ — 👑 3.5/5 👑The Judgment Day (Dominik Mysterio and JD McDonagh) def. Rey Mysterio and Dragon Lee — 👑 3/5 👑Rey Fenix def. Ethan Page — 👑 3.25/5 👑The Judgment Day (Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez) def. Sol Ruca and Lola Vice — 👑 3/5 👑Penta and Je'Von Evans def. The Vision (Bron Breakker & Austin Theory) — 👑 2.5/5 👑Recap "WWE Raw" with Uncrowned's live blog:

articles.title: CBI raid at Bhagwant Mann’s camp office, FIR against OSD; CM hits back at BJP
articles.summary: CHANDIGARH: The CBI has registered an FIR into corruption allegations involving Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann's Officer on Special Duty (OSD) Rajbir
articles.body: CHANDIGARH: The CBI has registered an FIR into corruption allegations involving Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann's Officer on Special Duty (OSD) Rajbir Ghuman and other senior officials, news agency PTI reported.The FIR follows a Punjab and Haryana high court order directing a probe into alleged irregularities in transfers, postings, government policies and tenders.The high court had directed the CBI to register an FIR after noting that material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) prima facie disclosed cognisable offences.The court had also sought a report on the probe within two months.The CBI has now registered the FIR into the allegations involving Ghuman and other senior officers.Govt to challenge CBI probeThe Punjab government has said it will challenge the high court order directing the CBI probe in the Supreme Court.Chief minister Bhagwant Mann rejected the allegations and accused the BJP of using central agencies against political opponents.Reacting to the development, Mann said in a post on social media:“BJP has started preparations for the Punjab elections. A CBI raid was conducted at my camp office. Now, the ED and CBI will be misused in Punjab to defame the Punjab government and me. The BJP is feeling nervous after seeing the love and support I am receiving from the people.”(With agency inputs)You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Chandigarh | Silver Rate in Chandigarh | Bank Holidays in Chandigarh | Public Holidays in Chandigarh | Chandigarh AQI | Weather in Chandigarh | Petrol Price in Chandigarh | Diesel Price in Chandigarh | CNG Price in Chandigarh | LPG Price in ChandigarhStay updated with the latest Chandigarh news. articles.title: Paramount closes historic Warner Bros. merger to form Skydance | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The deal brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network.
articles.body:
Paramount announced on Tuesday that it has completed its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery to create a combined company called Skydance.

The deal, which is one of the biggest mergers of all time, brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network. Skydance will also gain control of major franchises such as “The Lord of the Rings,” “Game of Thrones,” the DC Universe, and “Yellowstone.”

The merger puts one of the world’s largest entertainment studios under the control of David Ellison. Just last year, Ellison completed his merger of Skydance Media with Paramount, and is rapidly increasing his influence in Hollywood.

The Ellison family is Skydance’s largest shareholder, backed by the billions of Larry Ellison, David Ellison’s father and co-founder of Oracle.

The completion of the deal comes after settlements with a coalition of U.S. states and a Hollywood writers’ union cleared the main legal hurdles facing the merger.

Paramount announced in February that it would acquire Warner Bros. following a bidding battle with Netflix , which had previously reached an agreement to purchase Warner Bros.’ film and television studios and streaming business, excluding its cable networks.

Paramount had sweetened its bid by promising shareholders additional cash if the deal failed to close by a specified deadline and agreeing to cover the breakup fee Warner Bros. would owe Netflix for ending its existing agreement.

“Today is a historic day, not just for Skydance but for our entire industry,” Ellison said in a statement. “From the start, our ambition was to bring these two storied studios together and create a stronger competitor, with the talent, resources, and reach to tell great stories in every genre, on every platform, for audiences everywhere. Our focus now turns to the future: building a company that empowers creatives, entertains audiences and rewards shareholders. We couldn’t be more excited to get to work.”

The new combined Skydance corporation will have annual revenue of nearly $70 billion, the company says.

Skydance Class B shares will begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange today under the ticker symbol “SKYD.”

articles.title: Netflix expands TV game lineup with Conjuring spinoff
articles.summary: Netflix just announced The Conjuring: Unspoken, a new horror game set in The Conjuring universe that you can play with your phone as a controller, and it will launch exclusively on the service on October 13th.
articles.body: Netflix just announced The Conjuring: Unspoken, a new horror game set in The Conjuring universe that you can play with your phone as a controller, and it will launch exclusively on the service on October 13th. Here’s Netflix’s description of the game: > The Conjuring: Unspoken is an interactive paranormal investigation you can play from your couch. It’s a narrative experience, so you shape the story by choosing different dialogue options as you play. Using your phone, you scour the historic Red Lion Inn (reportedly a haunted place in England) for clues about things that go bump in the night. > As demonologist Francesca Noakes, you scan the area around you with an electromagnetic field reader, an infrared camera, and a spirit box — ghost-hunter tools of the trade for finding apparitions in the wild. The big screen shows your virtual environment, while the one in your hand serves as the controller for these tools. The infrared camera, for instance, allows you to see a thermal overlay of the environment while you’re looking for cold spots that indicate an otherworldly presence. Netflix says you don’t need to have seen the Conjuring movies to play the game, but adds that there are “a few familiar faces that pop up in the game, and knowing the backstory adds to the overall impact.” The Conjuring: Unspoken was developed by Supermassive Games, known for other narrative horror games like The Quarry and Until Dawn. The studio announced in August that it planned to lay off up to 75 staffers, and Supermassive’s former IT and facilities director said yesterday on LinkedIn that “more than 70” people would be leaving the studio. The new game follows the June launch of another horror title, Unhinged. That game was developed by Night School, the studio behind Oxenfree, but Netflix shut down the studio in August.

articles.title: The hotel TV privacy mistake that can follow you home
articles.summary: Hotel TV privacy risks go beyond forgotten passwords when you sign into Netflix or other streaming apps on shared devices you don't control.
articles.body: You've just arrived at your hotel after a long day of travel. The room looks good, the bed looks comfortable and there's a big TV on the wall with Netflix and your other favorite streaming apps ready to go. So, you grab the remote, sign in and settle in for the evening. Seems harmless, right? Here's the part that's easy to forget. That TV was used by plenty of guests before you, and more will use it after you leave. If you sign into a streaming service and forget to log out, your account could still be accessible after you've checked out and headed home. Before you reach for the remote, here's what to know about hotel TV privacy and the safer ways to stream while you're traveling. Missed CyberGuy LIVE? Watch the replay and discover 5 ways AI can help you get better health care. Our free CyberGuy LIVE class Get Better Healthcare with AI has ended, but you can still watch the full replay. Kurt "CyberGuy" Knutsson walks you through five practical ways AI can help you prepare for appointments, remember important details, understand complicated medical information, research prescription questions and organize your next steps. No technical experience is needed. Plus, recordings of all our past classes are available, including How to Stop Spam, Phone Security and Financial Protection, each with a free downloadable checklist. Watch the free replays and get your checklists at CyberGuyLive.com TRAVEL MISTAKE PUTS PHONE, LAPTOP AND STREAMING ACCOUNTS AT RISK Why signing into a hotel TV can create a privacy problem A hotel TV isn't your TV at home. It's a shared device that you don't control. When you sign into a streaming service, the app may create and store a session on that television so you don't have to log in every time you turn it on. That doesn't necessarily mean your password is sitting on the TV in plain text. But if the session stays active after you leave, the next person in the room may be able to open the app and use your account. Depending on the streaming service, that could let someone watch shows using your subscription, switch between profiles or see parts of your viewing activity. Netflix itself warns that a TV from a recent hotel stay can remain connected to your account. Its Manage Access and Devices feature lets you review recently active devices and sign them out remotely. There is another wrinkle here. Some newer hotel entertainment systems are designed specifically for guests and offer secure casting from your phone instead of requiring you to enter streaming credentials on the TV. Some of these systems automatically disconnect your device when you check out. That's a much better setup when it's available. Still, you can't assume every hotel TV works that way. What about smart TV tracking? Smart TVs can also collect information about what's being watched. Some television platforms use technology called Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) to identify content displayed on the screen and collect viewing information. The exact tracking depends on the TV, its software and its privacy settings. That doesn't mean every hotel television is tracking you personally or connecting your Netflix identity to everything you watch. Hotel TVs can use specialized commercial software and configurations that work differently from the smart TV sitting in your living room. But it's another reason I wouldn't treat a hotel television like one of my personal devices. FLORIDA SUES NETFLIX, ALLEGES STREAMER TRACKED CHILDREN AFTER PROMISING FAMILIES PRIVACY The smarter way to watch in your hotel room My preference is simple: keep your streaming accounts on devices you control. Your phone, tablet or laptop already has your streaming apps and account information. If you want to watch on the larger hotel screen, first check whether the hotel offers a casting option that lets you connect from your own device without entering your password on the TV. If it doesn't, an HDMI cable can be another option. Connect your laptop to the TV and switch the television to the correct HDMI input. Depending on your phone or tablet, you may also need a compatible USB-C or other video adapter. HDMI carries audio, video and certain control signals between devices, but connecting your laptop this way generally does not give the hotel TV access to the passwords, documents or other personal files stored on your computer. One caution: some hotel TVs have locked inputs or hotel equipment connected to the HDMI ports. If you disconnect anything to use the port, put it back exactly as you found it before you check out. What about hotel Wi-Fi? Hotel Wi-Fi deserves some attention too, although there's an important distinction here. Most major websites and streaming services use HTTPS encryption, which means your password and other information aren't simply sitting out in the open for another hotel guest to read. Still, you're connecting through a network you don't control. A VPN adds another layer of privacy by encrypting the connection between your device and the VPN server. If you use a VPN when traveling, turn it on before connecting to sensitive accounts or doing other private browsing. A VPN service can help reduce what the hotel network or Wi-Fi operator can see about your internet traffic. Just remember that a VPN doesn't make you invisible online. The streaming service you're using still knows you're connected to it. For the best VPN software, see my expert review of the best VPNs for browsing the web privately on your Windows, Mac, Android and iOS devices at CyberGuy.com. BEFORE YOU CONNECT ANOTHER SMART TV, TABLET OR PHONE, LOCK IT DOWN What to do if you're already signed in If you're reading this from your hotel room and you're signed into Netflix or another streaming service on the TV, there's no reason to panic. Before you leave, open the streaming app and choose Sign Out. Don't assume that closing the app or turning off the TV signs you out. If you've already checked out and can't remember whether you logged out, do this: 1) Check your signed-in devices. Look in your streaming service's account or security settings for recently active devices. Netflix has a Manage Access and Devices section that lets you remotely sign out individual devices. 2) Sign out the hotel TV remotely. If you see a device you don't recognize or one that appears to be the hotel TV, remove it. 3) Review recent account activity. Check profiles and viewing activity for anything you don't recognize. 4) Change your password if you see suspicious activity. Use a strong, unique password for that streaming account. A password manager can help you create and store a long, random password so you don't have to reuse one from another account. If you're changing a Netflix password, keep the Sign out all devices option selected so existing sessions are removed. 5) Check the service's security options. Some streaming accounts use verification codes or other additional checks for certain sign-ins and account changes. Turn on any additional account protection your service provides. Kurt's key takeaways I've stayed in enough hotels to know how tempting it is to drop your bag, turn on the TV and sign straight into Netflix. But I don't like putting my account credentials into a device I don't own, especially when I have other options sitting right in my bag. If the hotel offers secure casting from your phone, that's the first thing I'd look for. Otherwise, I'll use my own laptop or mobile device and connect to the television when possible. I also like using a VPN on hotel Wi-Fi for an added layer of privacy on a network I don't control. And if you do sign directly into that hotel TV, add one thing to your checkout routine: log out before you walk out the door. It takes a few seconds and could save you from discovering days later that somebody else is still enjoying your streaming account. Have you ever checked into a hotel and found someone else's streaming account still signed in on the TV? Let us know by writing to us at CyberGuy.com. articles.title: Former Hamas hostage counters Hasan Piker’s UT Austin event with her story of survival
articles.summary: Former Hamas hostage Maya Regev spoke at UT Austin on the same night Twitch streamer Hasan Piker addressed the University Democrats on campus.
articles.body: Controversial Twitch streamer Hasan Piker made waves with his visit to the University of Texas-Austin before he even made it into the Lone Star State. While he was speaking at an event last week hosted by University Democrats, a student group, another speaker with a much different point of view was telling her story of survival. Former Hamas hostage Maya Regev spoke to students with the goal of ensuring that they hear from someone who witnessed the horrors of Oct. 7, 2023, firsthand. In a recent conversation with Fox News Digital, Regev took issue with one of Piker's infamous remarks that "It doesn’t matter if rapes f---ing happened on Oct. 7, like that doesn’t change the dynamic for me." HAMAS USED SEXUAL VIOLENCE 'DELIBERATELY AND SYSTEMATICALLY' ON OCT 7, COMMISSION REPORT FINDS Regev said students concerned about cases like the sexual assault allegations against Cornell fraternity members may be listening to a person who's said "rape doesn't matter." Asked about his controversial remarks about the reported rapes committed by Hamas on Oct. 7, Piker told The New Republic that there was "definitely testimony of sexual violence that had taken place amongst the hostages. But that doesn’t change the dynamic of Israel committing a genocide against the Palestinians, and my opposing that genocide." Regev told Fox News Digital that Chabad, a Jewish organization with representatives across the globe, reached out to her about speaking at UT Austin after Piker's visit to the university was announced. "I'm not here to silence anyone," Regev told Fox News Digital. "I came there to let people hear what I've been through, like the other side of the story, with facts, with pictures, with records." UNIVERSITY EVENT WITH HASAN PIKER IN TEXAS DRAWS BACKLASH FROM BOTH SIDES OF THE AISLE The Anti-Defamation League has criticized Piker for what it calls his "antisemitic conspiracy theories and tropes," and has a list of some of his remarks about Oct. 7, including posting that Hamas hostage and American-Israeli soldier Edan Alexander had volunteered for the "Nazi army." Regev said that while Piker has freedom of speech and "can say whatever he wants," it was important for her to make sure students were getting more than one point of view. Regev also emphasized the fact that she was speaking from her own experience, not things she read about from others. "For me, October 7, it's not a debate, it's not something I read online. It's something that I've lived through, something that will forever be inside me, something that I will have to live with for the rest of my life," Regev told Fox News Digital. "I just think that it's important for them to understand that behind every story there are real human beings." "I was a hostage. I was a Hamas hostage," Regev told Fox News Digital. "I was being held by Hamas, by those monsters, and I think that students might, you know, forget that they are actually real human beings, real families that lost their lives, real women that got raped, men, lives were destroyed on October 7." Regev pushed back on Piker and other online influencers shaping students' opinions without firsthand knowledge. "When they hear an influencer post something, when they read something, it's important for them to check the facts before they are repeating a slogan or celebrating death of innocent people," Regev said. She later added, "I sat with those people. I lived with them for two months, with Hamas people ... I think that people should listen to a person who was really there and not to a person who just sees stuff online and has millions of followers." When asked what influencers like Piker get wrong about the situation in Gaza, she said that they overlook the realities on the ground, particularly Hamas' use of Palestinian civilians as human shields. "Hamas is using children and women and elderly women as a human shield," Regev said. "I think, again, people should know the facts before they're talking, and especially when you're very influencing." HASAN PIKER'S DEFENSE OF HAMAS HAVING 'RIGHT TO RESIST MILITARILY' DRAWS CONDEMNATION FROM HUMAN RIGHTS GROUPS On Oct. 7, 2023, Regev went to the Nova Music Festival with her brother Itay Regev and her friend Omer Shem Tov. When the rocket alerts began sounding at 6:29 a.m., Regev was not so alarmed, explaining, as someone who grew up in Israel, it was something she had experienced several times before that day. "We thought it was just a matter of time before everything will calm down, and we can keep on partying, but after some time we understood that it [was] a lot more serious than what we thought," she said. Regev explained that the group headed towards their cars before being told by police officers to abandon their vehicles and that terrorists had invaded the country. That's when Regev, her brother and Shem Tov began running for what she estimated to be 60 to 90 minutes. They then got a call from Ori Danino, a friend of a friend who was also at the festival. Danino had already gotten out of the danger zone, but decided to turn around and pick up the group to get them to safety. Unfortunately, all of them would be abducted and taken to Gaza. The group drove for about five minutes before "a big pickup truck" with terrorists began shooting at them, hitting Regev in both of her legs. Her brother was also shot. The terrorists dragged Regev, her brother and Shem Tov out of the vehicle before loading them into the pickup truck and driving them into Gaza. While Danino was initially able to escape, he was later caught by another group of terrorists and taken into the Strip. The Regev siblings were released from captivity in late November 2023, within a few days of each other. Regev described her release from Gaza as being bittersweet, feeling grateful to be home while worrying about her friends who were left behind. "It was a total shock. I thought that Omer will return home, like, a few days after me, but then the ceasefire was stopped. So, it was very hard for me. I couldn't believe that I escaped this hell, and they are still there being held, Ori, Omer, all the other hostages," Regev told Fox News Digital. HASAN PIKER CALLS HAMAS 'FAR MORE MODERATE,' DISMISSES TERROR GROUP’S BRUTAL RULE IN GAZA "I felt very guilty that I was saved, that I'm back home with my family. I can get the medical treatment that I needed to receive and there are people there suffering, still hostages suffering, not eating, being abused physically and mentally. But I understood that I have a voice now, and I have to use it, and I'll do anything in my [power] to bring them back home," she added. Danino would survive 11 months in captivity before terrorists executed him, along with Hersh Goldberg-Polin, Eden Yerushalmi, Carmel Gat, Almog Sarusi and Alexander Lobanov. Shem Tov endured 505 days in Hamas captivity and was released on Feb. 22, 2025. With her brother and Shem Tov back home, Regev is finally able to look to the future, something she wasn't mentally ready to do until all of the hostages were returned. Now, she's enjoying the simple things in life, walking outside, looking up at the sky. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE "I just want to do everything that makes me happy," Regev told Fox News Digital. "When I was there in captivity, I promised myself that I will live life. I told myself that if I'll ever be home again, I'll live life, and I'll study, and I'll go travel the world, and I'd be with friends and my family. And it's what I'm doing now, you know, I'm just doing whatever makes me happy." "I think that the only thing I wish for myself is to be happy forever and grateful for everything that I have." articles.title: Dodgers vs. Braves live updates, lineups: Chris Sale, Yoshinobu Yamamoto take the mound for Game 3, Shohei Ohtani drops to fifth in batting order
articles.summary: The Braves tied up the series with a 3-2 win over the Dodgers on the road Sunday.
articles.body: The Los Angeles Dodgers are headed east for Game 3 of the NLDS against the Atlanta Braves at Truist Park Tuesday, with first pitch at 6 p.m. ET, airing on FS1.The Braves tied up the series in a 3-2 win over the Dodgers on Sunday with a masterful bullpen game. Ray Kerr delivered 2 2/3 scoreless innings, while Grant Holmes, Dylan Lee, Robert Suarez, Didier Fuentes and closer Raisel Iglesias combined to limit the Dodgers to two runs in the rest of the game. Dodgers manager Dave Roberts was considering making lineup adjustments in the aftermath of their Game 2 loss, and he made a big one, dropping star Shohei Ohtani to fifth in the batting order — his lowest start in the lineup since 2020 with the LA Angels.The Dodgers will start right-hander Yoshinobu Yamamoto (14-9, 2.53 ERA), who allowed one run — a solo homer — on four hits with eight strikeouts over 6 1/3 innings in a 1-0 loss to Atlanta on Aug. 27.Left-hander Chris Sale (14-9, 2.16 ERA) will take the mound for Atlanta. He's pitched 7 2/3 innings this postseason with five hits and three earned runs allowed while striking out 12 of 30 batters faced.Follow along with Yahoo Sports for live updates, highlights and more as the Atlanta Braves host the Los Angeles Dodgers in Game 3 of the NLDS.

articles.title: Brewers vs. Padres live updates, starting pitchers, where to watch: Dustin May, Nick Pivetta take mound for Game 3 of NLDS
articles.summary: The Brewers took a 2-0 lead in the series with another win over the Padres on Sunday.
articles.body: The Milwaukee Brewers and San Diego Padres face off in Game 3 of the NLDS on Tuesday, airing live on FS1 with first pitch at 9:30 p.m. ET. The Padres return to Petco Park still seeking their first win of the series, with the Brewers up 2-0 after back-to-back home victories.Despite their 0-2 start, the Padres have been competitive, outscored by the Brewers just 7-5 in the series. The Brewers trailed most of Game 2 before some late-game heroics from Jackson Chourio, who hit a two-RBI, walk-off single into center field to drive in Sal Frelick and Christian Yelich.In Game 3, the Brewers will start right-hander Dustin May (7-9, 4.70 ERA), while the Padres send out right-hander Nick Pivetta (3-2, 2.86 ERA), with a 1.64 ERA in his five starts since returning from an elbow injury that sidelined him for most of the regular season.Follow along with Yahoo Sports for live updates, highlights and more as the San Diego Padres host the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 3 of the NLDS.

articles.title: AEW Grand Slam France results, grades: Will Ospreay fends off Kazuchika Okada atop stacked show
articles.summary: AEW made its first-ever stop in Paris for a special Tuesday mega-show, and though no titles changed hands, every match had something to like.
articles.body: AEW Grand Slam France went down on this Tuesday, Oct. 6, as the promotion made its first stop in Paris for a special mega-show. Fans inside Adidas Arena were treated to a loaded lineup of four championship matches. Although no titles changed hands, every match had something to like.Rain StopperWill Ospreay and Kazuchika Okada unsurprisingly shined in one hell of a main event for the AEW World Championship. Both men felt like the champions they are — not only in presentation, but in performance.In the end, Ospreay got the job done with his patented Hidden Blade after surviving two Rainmakers. Okada's greed ultimately cost him when going for a third, which was countered by a short Hidden Blade in tight before the final unpadded blow..@WillOspreay empties the tank to put @rainmakerXokada away and retain the AEW World Title!Watch #AEWGrandSlam France on TBS + HBO Max! pic.twitter.com/f5D4vP3dNm— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 7, 2026 After using the finisher to kick off his title reign, it feels pretty clear what AEW is doing with Ospreay and the Hidden Blade: It's being turned into his version of the One-Winged Angel. What I mean by that is, it's his automatic victory — specifically when he removes the elbow pad to land it. No one has ever kicked out of it, and seeing Ospreay stop a match off that single shot gives off that same feel as Kenny Omega's iconic match-ender, whether or not that truly is the booking intention. So kudos to Ospreay and the booking he's had to reach this point with a finisher.All in all, Ospreay and Okada made some magic tonight, and the International Champion felt like he may actually pull it off. If only he didn't go for that third Rainmaker.The Rainmaker isn’t enough to put @WillOspreay away!Watch #AEWGrandSlam France on TBS + HBO Max! pic.twitter.com/VpNy1ONWpb— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 7, 2026 Next, Ospreay has to worry about Clockwork Carnage at AEW WrestleDream 2026 next Saturday: The new multi-person stipulation match he brought to the company.Coffins and towersBelieve it or not, Darby Allin did not jump off the Eiffel Tower to defend his TNT Title against Kyle Fletcher in Paris. (I know, I'm just as surprised as you are.)This match was immediate chaos, as one can always expect from either man. And it was our lone bloodbath of the night, but only near the end, after Allin was spiked onto the exposed top turnbuckle with a hellacious Brainbuster. A Scorpion Death Lock followed by a pair of Coffin Drops got the job done for Allin, sending Fletcher on his way to challenge The Young Bucks for tag-team gold alongside Kevin Knight at WrestleDream. That's if the Bucks get through The Dogs on Saturday at AEW Grand Slam France, Night 2..@DarbyAllin may be FINISHED 😳Watch #AEWGrandSlam France on TBS + HBO Max! pic.twitter.com/dmZJLr1zlb— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 7, 2026.@kylefletcherpro has the TNT Champion in trouble, and “The Protostar” closes in!Watch #AEWGrandSlam France on TBS + HBO Max! pic.twitter.com/aLrQUu15Bh— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 7, 2026 May the series continueBandido kept the ROH World Title by besting Kofi to start the night. Really, every match we see of Kofi in AEW with a new face just feels so bizarre. The near-20 years in WWE are still rubbing off of the guy.Nonetheless, they put on a fine match that was nothing more than a tablesetter for the final chapter in The New Level's trios title saga with Brodido and "Hangman" Adam Page. Later in the night, it was revealed that New Level and Swerve Strickland will defend against the former champions one more time in a Two-Out-Of-Three Falls match at WrestleDream.Chaos erupts at ringside as @Bandidowrestler puts @TrueKofi away to retain the ROH World Title!Watch #AEWGrandSlam France on TBS + HBO Max! pic.twitter.com/l5h17yDdx1— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 7, 2026 Judging by their last match, this upcoming one should be even more chaotic, and it's safe to say we're headed toward a stronger continuation of the Strickland and Page feud. They couldn't take their eyes off each other ringside. A true rivalry made in Hell.👑 Uncrowned Gem of the Night 👑Anytime a professional wrestling show is in Paris, the crowd is almost always the Uncrowned Gem of the Night. That was true again tonight, as the French faithful got loud just from the graphics shown to start the show. Then there was the start of the main event. My word, what a scene.MY AEW GLORIOUSSSSSS#AEWDynamite pic.twitter.com/H8HlED78QM— Sebas ──★ セバスチャン──★ (@Sebas_Bucks) October 7, 2026 Knowing how French fans typically are, it was no surprise they showed up and showed out again for AEW's first appearance in the country.AEW Grand Slam France was a high-paced showcase of wrestling action that knew only one speed. There weren't any surprising outcomes, but it was a fun time. I give it a crown score of: 8/10 👑AEW Grand Slam France full card results and match grades:AEW World Championship: Will Ospreay (c.) def. Kazuchika Okada — 👑 4.75/5 👑AEW Women's World Championship: Mercedes Mone (c.) def. Queen Aminata — 👑 3.5/5 👑TNT Championship: Darby Allin (c.) def. Kyle Fletcher — 👑 4.25/5 👑The Don Callis Family (Mark Davis and Jake Doyle) def. Death Riders (Jon Moxley and Gabe Kidd) — 👑 3.75/5 👑Clockwork Carnage qualifying match: Samoa Joe def. Jungle Jack Perry — 👑 3.75/5 👑ROH World Championship: Bandido (c.) def. Kofi — 👑 3/5 👑Recap AEW Grand Slam France with Uncrowned's live blog:

articles.title: Disney Plus will stream Super Bowl LXI
articles.summary: Disney Plus subscribers will see the same Super Bowl broadcast airing on ESPN and ABC.
articles.body: Next year’s Super Bowl is headed to Disney Plus. On Wednesday, Disney announced that viewers will be able to tune in to Super Bowl LXI on its streaming service when the game kicks off on February 14th, 2027. Disney Plus subscribers in the US will see the same Super Bowl broadcast airing on ESPN and ABC simultaneously, featuring coverage from Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, Lisa Salters, and Laura Rutledge. The streamer will also air the Super Bowl in more than 55 international markets, including Latin America, South Africa, and Australia. This year’s Super Bowl streamed live on NBC’s Peacock, contributing to a boost in subscribers. In the months leading up to Super Bowl LXI, Disney Plus subscribers will also be able to watch two Monday Night Football games. The first game takes place on October 26th between the Dallas Cowboys and the Philadelphia Eagles, but the second matchup has not yet been announced.
